title: Realization of square-summable Hermite coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $c$ assign a real number $c_\alpha$ to each multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$. If $\sum_{\alpha\in\mathbb N^n} c_\alpha^2$ converges, then there is a function $g\colon\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ that belongs to $L^2$ for the product standard Gaussian measure and whose Hermite coefficient at every multi-index $\alpha$ is $c_\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb N^n$
The sum of the squares of all $c_\alpha$ converges
